example_sentences_in_bangla: আজকের গাড়ি ফেল করলাম, এখন পরেরটা অপেক্ষা করতে হবে।
সময়মতো না পৌঁছলে গাড়ি ফেল করতে হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: I missed the train today; now I have to wait for the next one.
If you don't arrive on time, you'll miss the train.
note: This idiom reflects the importance of train travel in Bengali daily life, especially in regions with extensive rail networks.
